description: This file defines the GetUserGroups class which retrieves all parent groups associated with a specific user. It interacts with the database to collect user group information from multiple related tables, including user-to-group, group-to-role, and group-to-role-subrole associations. The class also utilizes other utility classes and functions to compile a comprehensive list of user groups including inherited parent groups.

classes.name: GetUserGroups
classes.description: Class to retrieve all parent groups of a specified user, aggregating groups from user affiliations, user roles, and parent role hierarchies.

methods.name: getAllUserGroups
methods.description: Fetches all groups associated with the given user ID by querying user-to-group mappings, role-based groups, and parent role hierarchies; also includes parent groups of existing groups.
